_doc: FROZEN CHAMPION SNAPSHOT — the current STANDARD (favorite-tilted consensus). Written by Cycle-7 CONSOLIDATION. The standard is defined by CONFIG (see config block), NOT by any peak number. Every metric below is reproducible from the queries named in _reproduce. PAPER-ONLY. Nothing promoted, nothing armed, no Rust touched, DB read-only.
posture: PAPER-ONLY; promotes NOTHING; arms NOTHING; no Rust/migration edits; DB read-only; cost-zero (Max-only)

config._doc: The champion is the favorite-tilted consensus family: `favorite` + `elite_fresh_fav`. Defined in copy-trading-bot/src/scanner/consensus.rs::default_portfolio. Base params = ConsensusParams::default (the `strict` baseline). DO NOT change these to chase a number — a config change is a CHALLENGER, which must beat the champion via scripts/standard_guard.py before adoption.

elite_fresh_fav.role: elite-gated fresh favorite tail; positive but power-limited (indeterminate on its own)

belief_blind_evidence._doc: The evidence the edge is REAL and not a favorite-longshot selection artifact. Selection-matched null: surplus vs the band-matched `_blind` baseline, only the SELECTION randomized. Reproduce: python3 scripts/selection_null.py (2000 draws, seed 20260702).

favorite.bonferroni_note: 14 strategies tested; ×14 leaves favorite p still << 0.01 (p_emp < 1/2000)

elite_fresh_fav.verdict: indeterminate (power-limited; part of the family, not independently significant)

favorite_regime_persistence._doc: surplus vs regime x band-matched blind baseline; rule (c) = >0 in >=2 disjoint sport-regimes. Favorite is positive in ALL regimes it appears. BUT these are mostly EXPIRING regimes (World-Cup soccer, Wimbledon tennis) — the binding wall is NON-EXPIRING persistence over months.

audited_metrics._doc: TWO honest numbers, LABELED. (1) resolved-P&L = the canonical honest_paper_ledger, the number to treat as the baseline's TRUE realized performance. (2) realizable-edge = the CLV-minus-haircut view (the tracker's designed metric). They differ ~4x — the gap is the pre-ledger front-loaded window + pooled-vs-dedup + entry basis (see C1 reconciliation in RUN_JOURNAL). NEITHER is the screenshot's +63% headline (that is P&L / working-bankroll, a capital-velocity framing, optimistic).

resolved_pnl_canonical._doc: THE audited baseline. honest_paper_ledger, flat $100 stake, entry = COALESCE(entry_ask, mid+1c haircut), pnl = stake*((won-entry)/entry - fee). 07-01..07-06 (ledger start). Reproduce: SELECT strategy, COUNT(*), SUM(pnl), SUM(stake) FROM honest_paper_ledger WHERE strategy IN ('favorite','elite_fresh_fav') GROUP BY strategy.
resolved_pnl_canonical.regime_note: World-Cup-front-loaded and DECAYING: 07-02 peak +$852, then 07-03..05 = -$566, 07-06 +$77. The standard is the METHODOLOGY + belief-blind edge, NOT this unrepeatable peak.

realizable_edge_clv._doc: The tracker's designed 'realizable' view: outcome vs the mid we observed while open (CLV) minus an execution haircut, event-clustered. honest_pnl_by_strategy logic over the FULL consensus_signals record (06-29..07-06). This is a LEGITIMATE metric but is regime-dependent and front-loaded; the screenshot's +6.9%/+$2,008 is this view at an earlier snapshot.

band_aware_tax_event_clustered._doc: at the MEASURED band-aware follower tax (real_tax.json: b1 .0223 b2 .0273 b3 .0259 b4 .0235 b5 .0092). NOTE: at event-clustering the raw honest_roi LB straddles 0 (noisy binary outcomes) — the belief-blind SIGNIFICANCE lives in the selection_null surplus (z=4.28), not a t-test vs 0.

regression_floor._doc: Pre-registered floor the champion must not drop below (enforced by scripts/standard_guard.py). Keyed on the belief-blind selection surplus (the honest, band-matched metric), NOT raw P&L (too noisy) and NOT the peak (unrepeatable).

honest_caveats: The resolved-P&L baseline is only +2.2% on turnover over 229 bets and is DECAYING post-World-Cup (07-03..06 net negative ex-07-06). The VALUE is the DISCIPLINE (a protected, belief-blind-validated standard with a non-regression guard), not an inflated number.

The belief-blind edge (favorite p=0.0000) is real but the regimes carrying it are largely EXPIRING (World Cup, Wimbledon). The standing binding constraint is NON-EXPIRING regime persistence over MONTHS (see readiness_ledger persistence gate = NOT_MET).
Real-money eligibility is UNCHANGED: 2/4 GO gates, real_money_eligible=False. This consolidation promotes nothing and arms nothing.
